name: founder-guarded
description: Workspace default for interactive CLI work on founder-vn: the full toolset, the project skills, and the .kiro/hooks guard (secret paths, protected git operations, single-owner files).

preToolUse.command: bash -c 'd=$PWD; while [ "$d" != / ]; do s="$d/.kiro/hooks/guard.sh"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s"; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; printf "Refused: .kiro/hooks/guard.sh not found from %s; failing closed. Blocked by .kiro/hooks/guard.sh.\n" "$PWD" >&2; exit 2'
